_why: X1 follow-up, second try: Option A moved current onto the R1 funnel's east column. Step 6's 0.9/0.5 vias at x 72.25 broke clearance to U19 pins 15/16 on B.Cu, so these are 0.8/0.4 (the board's minimum for Vin) at x 72.08: about 0.28-0.30 mm from U19's pads and 0.28 mm hole to hole from the x 71.35 column. Every layer there is Vin copper, so no plane is cut.
